source.title: Maine In-State Commercial Drinking Water Labs (Maine CDC Drinking Water Program / Laboratory Accreditation)
limitations: The Maine CDC In-State Commercial Drinking Water Labs PDF is the list Maine’s private-well page links as “Find a lab that is certified to test your well water.” It is not, by itself, a statement that every listed lab currently accepts a sample you collect yourself.
The PDF does not print street addresses. Street address is unknown on every row; use the lab’s website or call.

Specialty notes (PFAS Only, Bacteria only) are transcribed exactly as printed on the PDF. Laboratories are accredited by test; confirm current accreditation with the lab or the Laboratory Accreditation Officer at (207) 287-2070.

Except for Health and Environmental Testing Laboratory (HETL), Well Labs Index has not independently verified that these laboratories currently accept private-well samples. HETL’s Environmental Chemistry page states the lab tests drinking water from private wells.
The PDF footer recommends checking bacteria holding times before mailing samples. Mail vs. drop-off is unknown unless you ask the lab. Prices are intentionally omitted.

A complete list of all labs accredited by Maine is available separately as an Excel file (All Accredited Laboratories) linked from the commercial PDF and accreditation page; this directory transcribes only the in-state commercial drinking-water list aimed at well owners.
